lastCompletedStory.title: Add real-tmux regression coverage for the trailing-space wrap boundary

nextStoryContext: US-003 (CAM-364) was the LAST story in this PRD (3 stories total: US-001 replaced the discriminator in src/tmux/dispatch.ts, US-002 corrected the real-tmux fixture to the word-wrap collision shape and ALREADY added the two real-tmux regression tests this story's acceptance criteria describe -- the len-77 trailing-space boundary payload in both drop mode (lines ~269-294, asserts 3 send-keys + 1 push-undelivered) and submit mode (lines ~296-320, asserts 1 send-keys + 0 push-undelivered), using WORD_WRAP_COLLISION_PAYLOAD = `'x'.repeat(PANE_WIDTH - 2*2) + ' '` = 77 chars at PANE_WIDTH 80). This story's only remaining delta was AC4: the stale comment at line ~175 referencing the retired `composerLineRetainsPayloadTail` backstop (inside the UNRELATED AC8 exact-paneWidth test, not the word-wrap tests) was updated to name the actual live discriminator, `cursorRowStartsWithPrompt` (US-001, CAM-364, src/tmux/dispatch.ts:375). No new test bodies were needed since AC1-AC3 and AC5 were already satisfied verbatim by US-002's prior work; verified by running `bun test test/integration/dispatch-geometry.test.ts` (7 pass, real tmux available on this machine) before committing. All 3 stories in the CAM-364 PRD now have passes:true pending supervisor flip. No further work is expected in this PRD; the next agent invocation (if any) is likely review/ship, not a new story.
